race.comment: SPENZALOT (2) didn't measure up in the Ken Howard two back but returned to form with a solid placing at Warwick Farm last time out. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Plenty to like about his prospects. JOIKA (7) was a dominant Scone winner last start and will have derived a bunch of confidence from that victory. Winning hoop Bullock sticks and can go back-to-back without surprising. MY GREEK GOD (11) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts and is a must for the multiples. POWERFUL PRAYER (9) has hit the top-five at his past 11 outings and may earn some minor money again. EXORBITANT MISS (3) has put a hat-trick of wins together, albeit in lesser company. Hard to knock mares in form.
